{"metadata":{"description":"Voice notes in, spoken answers out — dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), and leave walk-away narration on long headless runs. Local-first: plain audio files under ~/.dsh/voice/.","id":"gh:1333400604","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-voice","slug":"Jesse-njx/dsh-voice","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","plugin","speech-to-text","stt","text-to-speech","tts","voice"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Voice notes in, spoken answers out — dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" agent read replies aloud (speak), and leave walk-away narration on long headless runs. Local-first:"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" plain audio files under ~/.dsh/voice/."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-voice"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Voice notes in, spoken answers out.** Dictate audio that becomes user messages, and have the agent"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" read replies aloud. A hands-free terminal for DSH."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-voice` is a DeepSeek Harness bundle. Two tools, one durable event, one toggle:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **`transcribe({ source })`** — speech-to-text. Pass `{ file }` (an existing audio file) or `{ reco"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rd }` (record from the mic for a few seconds). The transcript becomes a **user message** the agent r"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"esponds to — never tool output — and the chat shows a compact **audio card** with play/pause, durati"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"on, backend badge, and the transcript as caption.
- **`speak({ text, voice?, rate? })`** — text-to-s"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"peech on a background job. The tool returns `{ jobId, audioRef }` immediately and never blocks the t"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"urn; playback happens async and a failure surfaces as an injected note. `speak` doubles as **walk-aw"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ay narration** for long builds and headless runs ("build finished, 0 failures").
- **`readReplies` +"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" `/voice`** — a per-session toggle that auto-narrates the assistant's reply text. Off by default; fl"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"ip it live with `/voice on`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The design center is **local-first**: audio is plain files under `~/.dsh/voice/` (inspect them, `rm`"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" them), nothing leaves the machine unless you explicitly configure a cloud backend, and nothing audi"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"o-related ever auto-runs — the model must call a tool."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why this shape"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A terminal agent handles two everyday moments badly: you're away from the keyboard and want to leave"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" an instruction (dictation), and you're mid-task and don't want to read a wall of output (narration)"},{"id":"p8s3","text":". dsh-voice is a thin layer over things DSH already exposes — `ctx.shell`, `ctx.jobs`, `ctx.settings"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"`, `ctx.attachments`, `ctx.conversationEvents` — so it stays useful without owning any audio pipelin"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"e itself. Audio is **plain files**, the session log holds only **refs + transcripts** (the attachmen"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"t/image-ref pattern), and replay reproduces the audio card without re-reading audio."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The bundle installs the `dsh-voice` entry (tools + `/voice` command + the web audio cards). Nothing "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"runs until the model calls a tool."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"All fields optional (profile patch or `cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Defaults: `stt.backend` auto-selected offline (whisper-local → macos), `tts.backend: say`, `readRepl"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ies: false`, `audioDir: ~/.dsh/voice`. **Cloud backends are never auto-selected** — `openai` and `ed"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ge-tts` are reachable only when you pin them. The `openai` backend reads its key through the standar"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"d credential seam (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, the same convention a polyglot preset would use), falling back "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"to the launching environment."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### `transcribe({ source, to? })`"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`source` is **exactly one** of:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- `{ file: <path> }` — transcribe an existing audio file.
- `{ record: { seconds? } }` — record from"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" the microphone (default 5s), gated on a recording path being available (ffmpeg or the bundled swift"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"(default 5s), gated on a recording path being available (ffmpeg or the bundled swift shim on macOS)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The transcript is **inserted as a user message**, not returned as tool output: a `voice/note` sessio"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"n event renders the audio card as a user-authored turn, and the text is delivered to the agent as us"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"er input. The canonical return is a compact handle — `{ transcript, audioRef, backend, durationMs }`"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" — so Code Mode callers get structured data."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"With **dsh-crosstalk** installed, `transcribe({ source, to: <peer> })` delivers the note to another "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"local session as a labeled peer message with the audio path attached (crosstalk owns provenance fram"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ing; the option simply isn't offered without it)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### `speak({ text, voice?, rate? })`"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Synthesizes + plays on a **background job** (`ctx.jobs`, kind `voice-speak`), returns `{ jobId, audi"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"oRef }` immediately. Every backend writes a durable file under `audioDir` first (the unit-testable s"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"eam), then plays it as a separate best-effort step. A job failure is injected as a note, never a thr"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"n plays it as a separate best-effort step. A job failure is injected as a note, never a thrown turn."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Because it's a plain tool over `ctx.jobs`, `speak` is callable from routines and headless runs — **n"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"arration *is* speak called from a job context**. No new surface."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Voice notes in chat"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Audio never enters the session log. The file lands under `audioDir`; the log holds one durable event"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"udio never enters the session log. The file lands under `audioDir`; the log holds one durable event:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Event | Role | Required durable facts |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `voice/note` | unique start | `noteId`, turn/step coords, `audioRef` (path + mime + durationMs), `"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"transcript`, `direction: 'in' \| 'out'`, `backend` |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Single-event business in v0.1 — `noteId` is the stable id, no update events. The web client renders "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"`voice-note` cards: inbound notes (STT) read as user turns, outbound (`speak`) as agent-side cards. "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"A missing or deleted file degrades to a transcript-only card — you're free to `rm` audio."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## `/voice`"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`readReplies` defaults follow config; the toggle is per-session and live."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Backends"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Speech-to-text (`dsh-voice-backends` module owns selection + the fake):"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- **`whisper-local`** — a whisper.cpp binary on PATH (or configured), invoked via `ctx.shell`. Fully"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" offline.
- **`openai`** — an OpenAI-compatible `whisper-1` endpoint via the standard credential sea"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"m. The only STT path that sends audio off-machine; only when configured.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Safety / privacy defaults"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Local-first** — audio never leaves the machine unless you explicitly set `stt.backend: openai` o"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"r `tts.backend: edge-tts`.
- **Plain files** — every artifact is a file under `audioDir` you can ins"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"pect or `rm`; the session log holds only refs + transcripts.
- **No auto-run** — recording and playb"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"ack happen only on an explicit tool call. `readReplies` narrates existing replies; it never records,"},{"id":"p37s5","text":" and it's off unless configured."}],"truncated":true}
